**[Leena AI](https://leena.ai/)**, a NYC-based provider of an enterprise agentic AI platform, received a strategic investment from IBM Ventures.

The amount of the deal was not disclosed.

The company intends to use the funds to support its growth as enterprise demand rises for AI agents that run back-office processes end to end.

Led by CEO Adit Jain, Leena AI provides an AI Colleague platform that deploys autonomous AI agents to resolve employee requests, execute multi-step workflows, and act across existing enterprise systems in HR, IT, and Finance. The solution integrates with systems such as SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle, and ServiceNow to automate business processes.

They improve operations for more than 500 global enterprises.
